title.en: Negative numbers · the other side of zero

description.zh: 负数记录“在基准的另一边、差多少”：温度计上的零下、电梯里的 B1、数轴上 0 的左边都是它；越往左越小，所以 −3 比 −7 大，加法向右走、减法向左走。
description.en: A negative number records “on the other side of the reference point, and by how much”: below zero on a thermometer, B1 in a lift, left of 0 on the number line; further left means smaller, so −3 is greater than −7, and adding steps right while subtracting steps left.

en: how to write a below-zero temperature

label.zh: 四个象限要用到负坐标

reason.zh: 把带正负的数轴横着、竖着各放一根，就铺成坐标平面；第二、三、四象限里的点至少有一个坐标是负数。
reason.en: Lay one signed number line across and one upright and you have the coordinate plane; every point in quadrants II, III and IV has at least one negative coordinate.

label.en: Why multiplying by a negative flips the sign

reason.zh: 数轴上 3 < 7，乘以 −1 后 −3 在 −7 的右边、反而更大；所以不等式两边同乘或同除一个负数，次序就要翻转。
reason.en: On the number line 3 < 7, but after multiplying by −1, −3 sits to the right of −7 and is larger; that is why multiplying or dividing both sides of an inequality by a negative number reverses the order.

label.en: Completing the number line to the left

reason.zh: 整数、分数和 √2 这样的无理数都要在同一根数轴上找到位置；负数把数轴从 0 向左补全，实数才铺满整根轴。
reason.en: Integers, fractions and irrationals like √2 all need places on one line; negative numbers complete it leftward from 0, so the real numbers can fill the whole line.
